description: Fabric mod: Follow another player hands-off, walked along on a rubber band or carried on a themed ride

mods.name: Follow Me
mods.description: Ask to follow another player, or ask them to follow you, and the follower rides along behind on a creature that suits the land: hands off, unhurtable, and never left behind

releases.notes:
- Following is always a ride now: the follower is on a creature every moment of it, which is smoother than being walked and never stumbles.
- Nothing parts follower and leader once it has started: not distance, not a portal, not a teleport, not the leader dying. Only /follow stop or leaving ends it.
- When the leader glides, flies or climbs, the ride takes to the air on a big flier that suits the place - a bee among the flowers, a parrot in the jungle, an allay in the cold, a bat underground - or a baby happy ghast anywhere else.
- The follower's view drifts round to the leader once they stop looking around themselves, and lets go the moment they move it.
- /follow assign <players> <leader> lets an op put one or more players behind a leader without asking, wherever they are.
- Mounts swap with the rider kept on, keep up with an elytra, and turn smoothly instead of snapping to each step of the trail.

mods.name: Follow Me
mods.description: Ask to follow another player, or ask them to follow you, and the follower is walked along behind: free to wander and look around a little, always pulled back in line

releases.notes:
- /follow asks to follow somebody, /follow lead asks them to follow you, /follow stop ends it.
- Add ride to either ask for a theme ride: carried behind the leader, hands off and unhurtable, on a creature that suits the land - a camel in the desert, a strider over lava, a nautilus at sea, a happy ghast over a drop.
- The follower walks the leader's own trail, jumps what is in the way, rides along in their boat and goes through portals after them.
- Within a few blocks nothing pulls; further out it tugs harder, like a rubber band.
- Falling too far behind loses the leader and ends it.
